source: When you boil it down to a weighted blend of quality (beer ratings) and quantity (breweries in proximity), Santa Rosa tops the list.
claim: Santa Rosa ranks first among cities with at least 5 breweries within 20 miles.
code:
(lambda ns: (exec("""
bb = b.assign(_id=np.arange(len(b)), _beer=b.beers.astype(str).str.split('|')).explode('_beer')
bb['_abv'] = pd.to_numeric(bb['_beer'].str.split('-').str[0], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
bb['_score'] = pd.to_numeric(bb['_beer'].str.split('-').str[1], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
bb['_reviews'] = pd.to_numeric(bb['_beer'].str.split('-').str[2], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
bb['_weighted'] = bb['_score'] * bb['_reviews']
bs = bb.groupby('_id', as_index=False).agg(name=('name','first'), cityIndex=('cityIndex','first'), cities=('cities','first'), score=('_weighted','sum'), reviews=('_reviews','sum'))
cp = bs.assign(_pair=bs.cities.astype(str).str.split('|')).explode('_pair')
cp['idx'] = pd.to_numeric(cp['_pair'].str.split('-').str[0], errors='coerce')
cp['dist'] = pd.to_numeric(cp['_pair'].str.split('-').str[1], errors='coerce')
cp = cp.dropna(subset=['idx','dist']).query('dist <= 20')[['_id','idx','dist']]
own = bs[bs.cityIndex.notna()].assign(idx=lambda d: d.cityIndex.astype(int), dist=0)[['_id','idx','dist']]
asn = pd.concat([own, cp]).sort_values(['_id','dist'], kind='stable').drop_duplicates('_id', keep='first')
asn = asn.merge(bs[['_id','score','reviews']], on='_id')
g = asn.groupby('idx', as_index=False).agg(count=('_id','size'), score=('score','sum'), reviews=('reviews','sum'))
g['score'] = g.score / g.reviews
g = g[g['count'] >= 5].merge(c, left_on='idx', right_on='index')
g['weighted'] = (g.score-g.score.min())/(g.score.max()-g.score.min())*80 + (g['count']-g['count'].min())/(g['count'].max()-g['count'].min())*20
grades = ['C-','C','C+','B-','B','B+','A-','A','A+']
g['grade'] = [grades[min(8, int((x-g.score.min())/(g.score.max()-g.score.min())*9))] for x in g.score]
g = g.sort_values(['weighted','score','count'], ascending=False, kind='stable').reset_index(drop=True)
g['rank'] = g.index + 1

result = g[['rank','city','state']].head(1)""", ns), ns["result"])[1])({"pd": pd, "np": np, "b": b, "c": c})
